text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the Shuka Sho approaching, Ikuno 
Dictus and Mejiro McQueen worked hard 
together in their training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Triple Tiara route and the Classic 
Triple Crown route. Though their paths 
differed, they spurred each other on 
through mutual dedication and elevated one 
another.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And the day of the Shuka Sho arrived. 
Ikuno Dictus's resolve remained 
unshakeable: to run with everything she 
had, and to keep running longer than 
anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer sends her off with strong 
encouragement. The decisive battle for the 
final crown, the Shuka Sho, begins now!
